note: COSINE LR DECAY 1e-2 -> 1e-4 over 15 epochs, zg5fnw's objective, overfit30 -> val10, lambda 0.00025. REVERTS THE STRADDLE FILTER, which was measured worse: over epochs 1-7 on the same 92 valfull interfaces zg5fnw (normal cross-seed softplus, DEFAULT_TAU 0.0305) is paired +0.00052 and above shipped in 4 of 7 epochs, peaking frac 0.7609 / DockQ 0.5878 against shipped 0.7391 / 0.5832, while 8fkrsu (straddle, tau 0.1429) is paired -0.00733 and above shipped in 0 of 7. THE ONE NEW VARIABLE IS THE SCHEDULE. weight_travel.py on both full-fold arms shows the weights parked at a fixed distance from the anchor for five epochs -- 5.55 for 8fkrsu, ~20 for zg5fnw -- while still moving 3-12 per epoch, gradient norms steady at 0.026, training loss flat; 8fkrsu's straightness is 0.227 against 0.462 for a free random walk of the same steps, so the trajectory is CONFINED and retracing, an optimiser oscillating at the limit its step size resolves. lr had been constant 0.01 after warmup in every arm ever run here because no decay existed until this commit. The anchor is not the constraint: 2*lambda*||W-W0|| = 5.55e-04 against a 2.6e-02 task gradient, 2.1% of the force, so lowering lambda cannot release anything. CRITERION: selected DockQ and fraction above 0.23 over the 18 val10 interfaces against shipped DockQ 0.2909 / frac 0.5556 / oracle 0.5968, from this run's own shards; Spearman is reported but is NOT the criterion. CONTROLS on the same pool and same trainable set: hronsr (+0.0116 paired over epochs 8-15, 8 of 8 positive), 6v6bbf, bjwcm5 -- all at constant lr 0.01, which is exactly what this arm changes. TEN-EPOCH MINIMUM before any trend claim. FALSIFIER: landing at or below the constant-lr controls on paired DockQ, which would say the oscillation diagnosed by weight_travel.py is not what limits these runs.
commit_subject: cosine lr decay, and the arm that reverts the straddle filter
